obligations.source_text: Create a photorealistic cinematic editorial photograph in a rain-flooded abandoned observatory at midnight. An unmistakably adult woman serves as the living operator. Her visible facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural styling follow the reference portrait. A living necromancer deliberately questions a specific dead astronomer by touching the astronomer's portrait medallion inside an abstract ring of smooth dark stones. A translucent apparition matching the medallion portrait forms above it. The apparition points toward one moving star while the wet brass chart needle has visibly shifted in response. Frame the operator, memorial anchor, apparition, and changed instrument together in a wide three-quarter view, with practical moonlight through the dome and physically coherent floor reflections.
